# Steven J. Hubbard

> Solutions Architect and Senior Frontend Engineer with 25+ years building enterprise
> digital platforms. Deep specialization in Adobe Experience Manager, with
> commerce and CMS work across Shopify, Adobe Commerce,
> and WordPress. Based on the US West Coast, available remote nationwide for
> contract and full-time work.

## What he is hired for

- Solution and domain architecture — as-is/to-be modeling, transformation roadmaps, technical debt tracking
- Integration architecture — REST, GraphQL, SOAP/WSDL, WebMethods, event-driven and SOA patterns
- Adobe Experience Manager architecture and development
- Ecommerce architecture and development — Adobe Commerce/Magento, Shopify, SFCC, WooCommerce
- CMS development and migration — AEM, WordPress, Drupal, Squarespace
- Data and reporting — Snowflake pipelines, SQL Server, ERP and commerce reconciliation
- Security and performance — OAuth, SAML, SSO, PCI compliance, Core Web Vitals
